cases.name: Confirmed QR sessions receive their site cookie before nav and publication
Existing usable QR device cookies need no initialization request
A sibling-scoped QR device cookie is replaced only in the candidate
Site failures never publish incomplete QR sessions and a fresh retry can succeed
Nav failure or device removal cannot publish an initialized but unverified candidate
Only valid manga-scoped nonexpired device Set-Cookie values are accepted
Unrelated site cookies cannot replace authentication or renewal state
Persisted contexts with a usable device cookie perform zero requests
Site recovery failures preserve every input field and remain retryable
Unvalidated sessions cannot use persisted-account site recovery
The production worker exposes site recovery without a separate session-update result
